ck_library_scope_owner.name: ck_library_scope_owner
ck_library_scope_owner.value: "question_library_scopes"."ownership_status" IN ('known','legacy_unassigned') AND ("question_library_scopes"."kind" <> 'private' OR "question_library_scopes"."ownership_status" <> 'known' OR length(trim("question_library_scopes"."owner_principal_id")) > 0 AND "question_library_scopes"."owner_principal_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_module_link_legacy.name: ck_module_link_legacy
ck_module_link_legacy.value: ("question_module_links"."legacy_student_question_id" IS NULL AND "question_module_links"."legacy_paper_question_id" IS NULL AND "question_module_links"."legacy_english_question_id" IS NULL) OR ("question_module_links"."module_type" = 'student_question' AND "question_module_links"."legacy_student_question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "question_module_links"."module_record_id" = CAST("question_module_links"."legacy_student_question_id" AS TEXT) AND "question_module_links"."legacy_paper_question_id" IS NULL AND "question_module_links"."legacy_english_question_id" IS NULL) OR ("question_module_links"."module_type" = 'paper_question' AND "question_module_links"."legacy_paper_question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "question_module_links"."module_record_id" = "question_module_links"."legacy_paper_question_id" AND "question_module_links"."legacy_student_question_id" IS NULL AND "question_module_links"."legacy_english_question_id" IS NULL) OR ("question_module_links"."module_type" = 'english_question' AND "question_module_links"."legacy_english_question_id" IS NOT NULL AND "question_module_links"."module_record_id" = "question_module_links"."legacy_english_question_id" AND "question_module_links"."legacy_student_question_id" IS NULL AND "question_module_links"."legacy_paper_question_id" IS NULL)

ck_source_document_paper.name: ck_source_document_paper
ck_source_document_paper.value: ("source_documents"."math_paper_id" IS NULL OR ("source_documents"."english_paper_id" IS NULL AND "source_documents"."source_type" = 'math_paper')) AND ("source_documents"."english_paper_id" IS NULL OR ("source_documents"."math_paper_id" IS NULL AND "source_documents"."source_type" = 'english_paper'))

ck_source_document_storage.name: ck_source_document_storage
ck_source_document_storage.value: "source_documents"."file_storage" IN ('r2','public','external','none') AND ("source_documents"."file_storage" = 'none' OR ("source_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("source_documents"."storage_key")) > 0))
